title: BBQ Spiced Chicken Breast with Sweet Potato Mash and Broccolini
desc: Lean weeknight barbecue: dry-rubbed chicken breast, sweet potato mash and broccolini. Good with a yoghurt sauce.

portions.J: On the plate: about 190 g cooked chicken (250 g raw), 300 g mash (a heaped cup and a half), 100 g broccolini
portions.P: On the plate: about 120 g cooked chicken (160 g raw), 175 g mash (a cup), 75 g broccolini

ingredients.name: Spices (paprika, garlic and onion powder, whatever you like)

steps.title: Rub the chicken
steps.text: If the breasts are thick, butterfly them or pound to an even thickness so they cook evenly without drying out. Coat both sides with the spices and a pinch of salt.

steps.title: Boil the sweet potato
steps.text: Cover with cold salted water, bring to the boil and simmer until a knife slides straight through.

steps.title: Barbecue the chicken
steps.text: Hot barbecue, no oil needed on a clean, well-heated grill. About 5 to 6 minutes a side until it hits 74°C in the thickest part. Pull it the moment it gets there: that's what keeps breast juicy.

steps.title: Rest, and cook the broccolini
steps.text: Rest the chicken 5 minutes under foil. Steam or microwave the broccolini until bright green and just tender, or throw it on the barbecue for the last 3 minutes.

steps.title: Mash and serve
steps.text: Drain the sweet potato, mash with the milk and season. Slice the chicken and plate up with the mash, broccolini and your sauce.

notes: Raw chicken breast loses about a quarter of its weight cooking, so 250 g raw is about 190 g on the plate. Weigh raw if you can; the cooked weights are a guide. A knob of butter in the mash adds about 70 kcal.
